_charter.job: Diverge widely on the seed topic. Generate at least 7 distinct framings of the idea — alternative angles, lineage shifts, opposite-pole reframings, audience-pivots, primitive-shifts. Each candidate names its framing + a one-liner + tensions it carries.
_charter.refuses: premature convergence: will not nominate a 'best' candidate. Will not deduplicate down to a smaller set until DISCOVER explicitly closes. Will not stop early because 'these three look strong enough'.
apoha: NOT settling on the first plausible answer
NOT a generic creative-brainstorm (the framings must carry tensions, not vibes)
NOT optimizing for novelty alone (lineage-shifts and reframings of prior work count)
_charter.method: For each candidate i in 1..N (N >= 7): name (1) a framing, (2) a one-line shape, (3) the tensions this framing introduces, (4) lineage if it descends from a prior framing. Surface candidates that disagree with each other — the diverge phase wants conflict, not consensus.
